Merge commit shape.question: How should the 33 source/test conflicts be resolved in Phase 6, given Phases 7-10 do the actual semantic work?
Merge commit shape.answer: Upstream's file, verbatim. Every conflicted source/test path resolves to upstream v1.6.0's exact file via stage-3 --theirs (NOT -X theirs hunk-merging). The 5 modify/delete conflicts resolve as deletions. Auto-merged files stay as git produced them. Fork-only files are added untouched. Property is script-verifiable: git diff v1.6.0 <merge-sha> -- <conflicted paths> is empty. src/main will not compile until Phase 7, as the roadmap expects.
options_presented: Keep fork's side where fork is more complete
Hold the merge uncommitted across phases

Merge commit shape.question: Does the build/infra resolution go inside the merge commit, or in a follow-up commit right after it?
Merge commit shape.answer: Two commits. Commit 1 = the merge, 100% mechanical, every conflicted path upstream verbatim including build.gradle.kts/VERSION/wrapper. Commit 2 = ordinary commit re-applying the five fork build additions, VERSION -> v1.6.0_gg1, .gitignore, tests.yaml. The Phase 6 gate (gradlew help + dependencies) runs on commit 2. git revert -m 1 still targets the merge commit cleanly.

Merge commit shape.question: Commit 2 has to settle .gitignore and .github/workflows/tests.yaml - both conflict, both belong to other phases. Which way?
Merge commit shape.answer: Fork's tests.yaml verbatim (the 55-line single job; upstream's 245-line 3D matrix + cloud + cluster dropped; revisit only in Phase 11 for CI-05). .gitignore resolved as a union of both sides - nothing lost either way.
options_presented: Defer both to their owning phases

Merge commit shape.question: Does sync/v1.6.0 get pushed to origin (the public fork) while Phases 6-10 are in flight, or stay local until Phase 11?
Merge commit shape.answer: Stay local until Phase 11. No broken branch on the public fork, no red CI (tests.yaml is on: [push], unqualified - it fires on every branch). Phase 11 pushes custom_build once, which is the only SHA CI-06 needs.
options_presented: Push, and gate CI off the scratch branch
Push and let CI run red
